text:
rachel: starting warmstart canary for akari-18b int4. seeing intermittent OOMs during early traffic spikes (10-15% of canary starts). posting short traces to #stack-traces.
devin: where exactly does it fail? model load, kv init, or prefetch alloc?
rachel: allocator fails during the prefetch path when priming KV and reserving warmup slots; trace shows many small free blocks and then a medium alloc fail.
mohit: could be slab fragmentation from int4 kernels + aggressive max_new defaults. what are the request shapes?
rachel: most repros are ~800-1100 token prompts with default max_new_tokens still at 1024. prefetch.enabled=true and strategy=eager on canary.
tara: yikes. 1024 default + eager prefetch on 18B int4 is risky. suggestion: reduce service.default_max_new_tokens to 256 for canary and switch prefetch to windowed.
devin: agree. also reduce prefetch.reserve_ratio to 0.1. with concurrency 4 those reservations blow up memory fast.
mohit: quant note: int4 allocator uses 4KB slab chunks for small tensors; many small allocations create internal fragmentation. possible fixes: larger superblock size for akari, or pooled contiguous buffers for KV/prefetch.
rachel: action proposals: 1) canary defaults -> max_new 256, prefetch.reserve 0.08, prefetch.strategy=windowed; 2) add light compaction call between heavy sessions (defrag hook); 3) instrument fragment_ratio and early OOM alerts; 4) per-route allow_long_gen opt-in.
tara: quick bench after locally simulating: old defaults p50=140ms p95=790ms token/s=160; new defaults (256/0.08/windowed) p50=102ms p95=360ms token/s=210; no OOMs in 250 runs.
devin: create guard: if prompt_len + requested_max_new > 1500 then require explicit per-route flag or route to dedicated capacity. prevents silent heavy allocations.
mohit: long-term: change allocator to superblocks and prefer pooled KV buffers; also tune cudaMallocAsync usage pattern to reduce fragmentation.
ops-bot: queued deploy canary-config/akari-prefetch-tweak (job ak-5971). will post status.
rachel: minimal repro for loadtool: POST /v1/generate {"model":"akari-18b-int4","prompt":"<~1000 tokens>","max_new_tokens":1024,"prefetch":true} run with concurrency=3 to reproduce quickly.
tara: I'll author a short customer note explaining default change and how to opt-in for longer generations.
devin: add alert: host.fragment_ratio > 0.6 => trigger compaction and scale-down prefetch for new sessions.
mohit: I'll open an internal ticket rw-alloc/akari#5 for superblock experiment and link the bench numbers.
rachel: rolling the canary change now, monitoring OOM_count and fragment_ratio for 48h. will update thread with results. thanks all :sparkles:
